proposals.logical_status: Conditionally sound teacher formulation; completion/action/state contracts need revision
proposals.supported_core: Different histories at the same physical pose can have different efficient satisfying continuations.
required_changes: Separate efficient action set Y from semantic feasibility. Audit complete teacher continuations including STOP; a recoverable first detour is not itself a semantic violation.
For any finite-budget semantic claim, declare remaining budget B and evaluate feasibility c+V*<=B separately from optimality.
Use a fixed common primitive-neighbor-plus-STOP pilot, or augment the teacher state with changing observed map/menu information for native macro actions.
Align endpoint-forced termination, cached STOP return, budget exhaustion and all intermediate macro-route events with the completion contract in every comparison.
Define ambiguous action labels separately from masked state labels; do not silently union incompatible state-specific action sets.
Specify transferable state/automaton encoding and which event evidence is actually observed by the deployed policy.
proposals.proof_status: Bellman descent and set-loss gradient derived under finite deterministic positive-cost graph assumptions; no learned-policy guarantee.
untested_assumptions: Natural rate of semantically invalid teacher continuations
proposals.next_decisive_test: Blinded full-continuation teacher audit with separate semantic, efficiency and unresolved labels.
proposals.recommendation: Proceed to revised diagnostic audit, not model training yet.

proposals.logical_status: Constrained selection is well defined; witness and label-population semantics need revision
proposals.supported_core: Instruction-route validity is not logically equivalent to a named navigator successfully executing it.
required_changes: Use complete alternative witness bundles or separately supervised required evidence groups; union-attention loss does not enforce conjunction.
Treat unresolved as annotation/evidence status and report selective label availability. Masked losses need an explicit population/support assumption or randomized audit.
Declare whether hard quotas may select low-validity examples or may abstain/be infeasible under a quality floor.
Keep generator/navigator/scorer separation procedural; do not claim probabilistic independence.
Match human evidence-label effort and downstream token/update budgets in addition to accepted pair count.
proposals.proof_status: Top-B_k selection per disjoint stratum follows by exchange argument; no learning-performance guarantee.
untested_assumptions: Witness supervision improves validity beyond simple scorer
proposals.next_decisive_test: Independently sampled validity-by-difficulty audit with resolved/unresolved coverage and complete witness definitions.
proposals.recommendation: Proceed to revised diagnostic audit; no demonstrated method benefit.

proposals.logical_status: Strong symbolic aliasing result survives; real target impact and learnability remain speculative
proposals.supported_core: Timewise event marginals and ever-event probabilities can both match while ordered co-occurrence differs.
required_changes: Replace AA/BB versus AB/BA as evidence beyond p-only with uniform {AB0,B0A,0AB} versus {A0B,0BA,BA0}.
Describe NavQ as expected discounted sum of caption features under its shortest-continuation construction, not normalized average.
Preserve the continuation policy/horizon and same-continuation pair labels; do not interpret J as optimal reachability or risk guarantee.
Necessary pairwise bounds do not guarantee coherent trajectory probabilities. State single-occurrence/repetition assumptions before additional constraints.
Require natural target/readout headroom and observable predictive signal before training a new head; retain matched future-QA, sequence, capacity, task-input and supervision controls.
proposals.proof_status: Analytic equality of additive targets follows from identical timewise marginals for any fixed event feature map and discount; does not establish collision for actual NavQ caption features.
untested_assumptions: Relevant target-level ambiguity exists in natural data
Compact joint head beats ordinary sequence/future-QA controls
proposals.next_decisive_test: Oracle representation comparison on matched-marginal branches and natural cases, followed by an observability/learnability test.
proposals.recommendation: Retain only as speculative; drop the method claim if direct controls match.

proposals.logical_status: Outcome-only failure attribution is not identifiable; a conditional evidence-based classifier is plausible but unvalidated
proposals.supported_core: A failed arrival can coexist with a correct identity detection; terminal failure is not sufficient evidence of wrong category.
required_changes: Measure write prevalence and causal downstream suppression before attributing practical harm; preserve collection-enabled and simulator-feedback conditions.
Define deployable identifying evidence; same-observation hidden causes cannot be separated merely by extra heads.
Address selectively observable attribution labels and distinguish balanced interventions from natural failure prevalence.
Restrict identity-invariance pairs to verified identity/evidence-preserving interventions.
Evaluate precision and coverage of the joint qD/witness gate. Global qD calibration alone does not survive arbitrary correlated witness conditioning.
Keep static memory, no-write, quarantine and witness-only controls; paper Table4 already reports small static-versus-dynamic increments.
proposals.proof_status: Restricted success truth table proves non-identifiability from outcome alone; no general identification or deployment-risk theorem.
underlying_evidence: PSG-Nav PDF p.6, section3.4; p.9, Table4
untested_assumptions: Their downstream effect survives quarantine baseline
Intervention labels transfer to natural episodes
proposals.next_decisive_test: Shadow-write and retrieval replay with independent identity/control labels and natural-prevalence sampling.
proposals.recommendation: Proceed only to the revised write audit; do not claim a new memory benefit yet.
